passed_scope: Printable meshes, independently checked center holes and end pads, shared dipole-center parity with and without strap slots, BNC fit coupon diameters and matching upright center cutouts, preserved raised center structure and original winder geometry, complementary left/right spine-to-spine packing with two engaged studs, blocked lateral motion and pivoting, and colliding same-hand negative controls, opposite-side wire reserves, separation, two center-end tie slots, and a continuous rear-only tie route that clears individual coil ties and their buttons. All supported joint clearances must pass; schematic load-proxy intersections are reported separately.
evidence: Nominal CAD checks only. No physical fit, printed strength, hand comfort, retention, or wire-capacity test.

spine_winder_joint.joint_behavior: Both studs enter opposite handed sockets. The second station stops pivoting; the rear strap retains the bundle against separation.
spine_winder_joint.outward_extraction_direction: Translate the flipped left winder in -Y after full vertical disengagement.

assembly.center_pose: Representative flat packing pose with at least 2 mm for the rear strap over the higher wire reserve; no printed center-to-winder locating holes or asserted frame contacts.

rear_tie.route: From each narrow center-end slot, outward under the center above the coils, around both coil ends, and across the back; no front wrap.

load_proxies.assumptions: Schematic BNC/M3 hardware and a 12.7 mm wide, 2 mm thick rear tie routed outward below the narrow center before passing behind both winders. Rectangular wire reserves describe packing space, not individual turns. The left winder turns over around the X/spine axis to nest the spines with winding sections on opposite sides and a 12 mm XY gap between reserves. Independent coil ties include a 12 mm wide, 2 mm thick loop and an 8 mm diameter, 2 mm thick closure button. Some nominal tie edges touch without intersecting; actual bending and closure clearance need a physical check. Both studs engage the opposite sockets. The upper coil tie and its closure button turn over with the left winder. The center is shown in a flat packing pose; nominal proxy clearance does not establish physical winding capacity, hardware fit, comfort or retention.
